cartridges.title: DSP1 (World) (Enhancement Chip)
cartridges.source: snes-roms/5 Tools & Service Test Carts/CPU/ in the local library, the 8,192-byte file with this digest
cartridges.layout: Each 3-byte program word and 2-byte table word stored low byte first; reversing every word gives the image the manifest pins for dsp1
cartridges.exercises: The microcode the DSP-1 and the DSP-1A, which runs the same image runs, run by this member: conformance/testroms.py puts it back in the published order, builds each part that runs it, and re-derives every answer the corpus recorded for that part. The image reports no verdict of its own, so the verdict is whether every recorded answer comes back
